skill.name: free-tool-strategy
skill.description: When the user wants to plan, evaluate, or build a free tool for marketing purposes — lead generation, SEO value, or brand awareness. Also use when the user mentions "engineering as marketing," "free tool," "marketing tool," "calculator," "generator," "interactive tool," "lead gen tool," "build a tool for leads," or "free resource." This skill bridges engineering and marketing — useful for founders and technical marketers.
skill.summary: Plan and evaluate free marketing tools that attract traffic, generate leads, and support product growth.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: The flagged external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences around strategy templates. The low reconnaissance findings are ordinary marketing strategy phrases, not instructions to inspect networks or systems.

finding_verdicts.reason: Lines 457-468 are a Markdown code fence for an ROI projection template. It contains placeholders and arithmetic guidance, not Ruby backtick execution or shell commands.
Lines 468-476 close the ROI template and begin another Markdown example block. The backticks are documentation formatting, not executable code.
Lines 476-514 define the expected output format for a strategy document. The content is plain Markdown structure with placeholders and no command execution path.
The phrase is about UTM parameters for paid marketing attribution. It does not request system discovery, host inspection, or environment reconnaissance.
The phrase describes market data that users may want for business planning. It is not a request to scan networks or access restricted systems.
The phrase appears in a promotion strategy section about sales conversations. It contains no network enumeration or technical reconnaissance instruction.

content.value_statement: Free tools can attract buyers, but weak ideas waste build time. This skill helps plan, score, launch, and measure tools for growth.
actual_capabilities: Classifies free tool ideas by type, including calculators, generators, analyzers, validators, resources, and educational tools.
Evaluates ideas using audience fit, search demand, uniqueness, feasibility, maintenance burden, and link potential.
Recommends lead capture approaches, including gated, partially gated, optional capture, and ungated models.
Outlines build options across custom development, no-code tools, and embedded third-party tools.
Produces strategy documents with concept, audience, SEO opportunity, MVP scope, metrics, promotion, and timeline.
limitations: It does not build the tool or write production application code by itself.
Search volume, competition, and cost estimates need current external research.
It depends on clear business context, target audience, product fit, and resource constraints.
It does not replace legal, privacy, or security review for tools that collect user data.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Tool Ideas
use_cases.description: Score several free tool concepts and choose the best candidate for growth.

use_cases.title: Plan Lead Capture
use_cases.description: Design a capture model that balances usage, email collection, and follow-up quality.

use_cases.title: Scope an MVP
use_cases.description: Translate a marketing tool idea into a focused build plan and launch timeline.

prompt_templates.title: Brainstorm Tool Ideas
prompt_templates.prompt: Use free-tool-strategy to suggest free tool ideas for my business. My product is [product], my audience is [audience], and my goal is [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate One Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Use free-tool-strategy to evaluate this tool idea: [idea]. Score it for audience fit, SEO demand, uniqueness, feasibility, and lead quality.

prompt_templates.title: Create Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use free-tool-strategy to create a launch plan for [tool idea]. Include target keywords, lead capture, promotion channels, metrics, and timeline.

prompt_templates.title: Build Full Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use free-tool-strategy to create a complete strategy document for [tool idea]. Include concept, MVP scope, build approach, SEO plan, capture model, metrics, and risks.

output_examples.input: Plan a free calculator for a B2B billing SaaS.
output_examples.output: A strategy document for a pricing leak calculator, with target users, SEO keywords, partial gating, MVP scope, success metrics, and promotion channels.

output_examples.input: Compare three free tool ideas for an agency.
output: A scorecard ranking a scoping calculator, benchmark report, and website audit tool.
A recommendation based on buyer fit, search demand, build effort, and maintenance risk.

output_examples.input: Define lead capture for an ungated SEO tool.
output_examples.output: A capture plan that keeps the tool free, offers emailed results, adds one qualifying question, and routes leads into a relevant nurture sequence.

best_practices: Start with one audience problem and one clear tool outcome.
Validate search demand, buyer fit, and build effort before committing development time.
Measure acquisition, engagement, conversion, and pipeline impact after launch.
anti_patterns: Do not gate basic utility before users see value.
Do not build broad tools that lack a clear path to the paid product.
Do not rely on launch traffic without an ongoing SEO and promotion plan.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps plan free marketing tools that attract traffic, generate leads, or build brand awareness.

faq.question: Can it choose the best tool idea?
faq.answer: It can score ideas and recommend a priority, but current market research improves the decision.

faq.question: Does it create production code?
faq.answer: No. It creates strategy, MVP scope, launch plans, and implementation guidance.

faq.question: Which tool types does it support?
faq.answer: It covers calculators, generators, analyzers, validators, resource libraries, and interactive educational tools.

faq.question: Can it help with lead capture?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares gated, partially gated, optional capture, and fully ungated approaches.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
